description: Create a new Security Case Priority in OneUptime. Returns the created Security Case Priority object with its ID. Use this to add new Security Case Priorities to your project. Note: projectId is inferred from your API key — you do not need to provide it.

color.description: The priority's colour, in hex (#32a852 for example).

description.description: How fast a case at this priority needs a person, in a sentence.
description.example: This is an example of longer text content that might be stored in this field.

isArchived.description: Archived priorities stay on the cases at them, but can't be picked again. The built-in priorities can't be archived.

isCriticalPriority.description: Is it the priority Critical detections open cases at? From it up, a case can't wait. A project has one; it can't be deleted or archived.

isHighPriority.description: Is it the priority High detections open cases at? From it up, a case counts as urgent. A project has one; it can't be deleted or archived.

isInformationalPriority.description: Is it the priority Informational detections open cases at? A project has one, and it can't be deleted or archived.

isLowPriority.description: Is it the priority Low detections open cases at? A project has one, and it can't be deleted or archived.

isMediumPriority.description: Is it the priority Medium detections, and the cases people open, start at? A project has one; it can't be deleted or archived.

name.description: What the priority is called, like High or P1.

order.description: Where this priority ranks among the project's security case priorities: 1 is the most urgent. Detections open their cases at the critical, high, medium, low and informational priorities, so those have to stay in that order. A new priority without a number goes to the end of the list. Setting a number moves the priority to that place, and the ones in between shift by one. In the dashboard, drag the rows to reorder them.

projectId.description: ID of the project this priority belongs to.

name: create_security_case_priority
title: Create Security Case Priority
